mapper.select: SELECT examflag FROM ttokssaemdb.checkvocaplan WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND memodate = #{memodate}
SELECT IFNULL(max(degree), 0) degree FROM ttokssaemdb.vocaexam WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND memodate = #{memodate}
SELECT answer FROM ttokssaemdb.voca WHERE vocalevel = #{vocalevel} AND vocano = ${vocano}

SELECT id, memberid, memodate, vocalevel, (SELECT codename FROM cmm_code WHERE code = vocalevel AND codetype = 'VOCALEVEL') vocalevel_name, vocano, word, `explain` FROM ttokssaemdb.vocamemo WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND memodate = #{memodate}
SELECT IFNULL(max(degree), 1) as degree FROM ttokssaemdb.vocaexam WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND memodate = #{memodate}

SELECT id, memberid, memodate, vocalevel, (SELECT codename FROM cmm_code WHERE code = vocalevel AND codetype = 'VOCALEVEL') vocalevel_name, vocano, word, '' answer, result FROM ttokssaemdb.vocasolve WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND memodate = #{memodate} AND degree = ${degree}

SELECT A.*, B.passrate FROM ( SELECT memberid, memodate, count(*) total, SUM(IF(result = 'X', 1, 0)) AS wrong FROM ttokssaemdb.vocasolve WHERE memberid = #{memberid} and memodate = #{memodate} and degree = ${degree} ) A, ttokssaemdb.vocaplan B WHERE A.memberid = B.memberid
